bbox.description: Viewport bounding box as 'minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat' in decimal degrees.

limit.description: Maximum number of pins to return. Most-liked photos win when the box is dense.

category.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on postMeta categories, narrowing the viewport pins to one category.

main.description: Retrieve geotagged Zeens photos inside a geographic bounding box. Powers the Explore map: each result carries its lat/lng (decoded from the int*1e7 stored in postMeta), the first image cid for a thumbnail, the author identity, and the like count for ordering co-located stacks.
